headline: Indian IT services posted mixed revenue growth with AI as a key driver.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY jump. Most peers reported double‑digit growth, but Infosys trimmed guidance to 1‑2% and saw only 1.5% revenue rise. Profit margins improved for several firms as AI‑related contracts expanded. Dividend payouts remained stable for most companies.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue surged at LTM (47%), Mphasis (71% of pipeline) and HCLTech ($219 m), boosting top‑line growth.

themes.title: Margin guidance and pressure
themes.detail: Coforge raised FY27 EBIT margin to 16%; Infosys cut revenue guidance, indicating margin pressure at larger players.

themes.title: Dividend stability
themes.detail: Most companies declared or maintained interim dividends, supporting shareholder returns.

leaders.why: Revenue grew 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
